title: Flexibility of flanking DNA is a key determinant of transcription factor affinity for the core motif.
one_liner_zh: 该文通过实验引导的分子动力学模拟研究Hox转录因子异二聚体与DNA复合物，揭示侧翼序列的DNA柔性通过别构效应调控核心基序的TF结合亲和力，属于TF-DNA互作机制与物理模拟方法高度匹配的核心文献。
abstract: Selective gene regulation is mediated by recognition of specific DNA sequences by transcription factors (TFs). The extremely challenging task of searching out specific cognate DNA binding sites among several million putative sites within the eukaryotic genome is achieved by complex molecular recognition mechanisms. Elements of this recognition code include the core binding sequence, the flanking sequence context, and the shape and conformational flexibility of the composite binding site. To unravel the extent to which DNA flexibility modulates TF binding, in this study, we employed experimentally guided molecular dynamics simulations of ternary complex of closely related Hox heterodimers Exd-Ubx and Exd-Scr with DNA. Results demonstrate that flexibility signatures embedded in the flanking sequences impact TF binding at the cognate binding site. A DNA sequence has intrinsic shape and flexibility features. While shape features are localized, our analyses reveal that flexibility features of the flanking sequences percolate several basepairs and allosterically modulate TF binding at the core. We also show that lack of flexibility in the motif context can render the cognate site resistant to protein-induced shape changes and subsequently lower TF binding affinity. Overall, this study suggests that flexibility-guided DNA shape, and not merely the static shape, is a key unexplored component of the complex DNA-TF recognition code.
abstract_zh: 选择性基因调控是通过转录因子（TFs）识别特定DNA序列来介导的。在真核基因组中数百万个潜在位点中搜寻特定同源DNA结合位点这一极具挑战性的任务，是通过复杂的分子识别机制实现的。该识别代码的要素包括核心结合序列、侧翼序列背景，以及复合结合位点的形状和构象灵活性。为了揭示DNA灵活性调节TF结合的程度，在本研究中，我们采用实验引导的分子动力学模拟，对密切相关的Hox异二聚体Exd-Ubx和Exd-Scr与DNA的三元复合物进行了研究。结果表明，嵌入在侧翼序列中的灵活性特征影响TF在同源结合位点的结合。DNA序列具有内在的形状和灵活性特征。虽然形状特征是局部的，但我们的分析揭示，侧翼序列的灵活性特征会渗透多个碱基对，并通过别构方式调节核心处的TF结合。我们还表明，基序背景中缺乏灵活性可使同源位点对蛋白质诱导的形状变化产生抵抗，从而降低TF结合亲和力。总体而言，这项研究表明，灵活性引导的DNA形状，而不仅仅是静态形状，是复杂DNA-TF识别代码中一个尚未探索的关键组成部分。
